row.title: Every config has a JSON Schema; standards before home-grown formats
row.body: OPEN-STANDARDS-1: syntaxes (YAML, TOML, JSON) do not make surfaces interoperate, shared schemas and protocols do. Every JSON config in the platform and seed is validated against a draft 2020-12 schema in a SchemaStore-format catalog; the standards register lists every standard as supported, partial or planned with an executor item; OpenSSF Scorecard and the SPDX SBOM feed a weekly loop.

title: Every config has a JSON Schema; standards before home-grown formats
